task.description:
Implement EE-10 (Execution error handling) per the EE-10 design section in src/design/engine.md (appended after line 4567). Key deliverables:
1. Implement setInstanceError in src/engine/instance.zig: single function that atomically INSERTs EXECUTION_ERROR event + UPDATEs instance_projections.status=ERROR+error_detail in one transaction. Callers: gateway no-match path (EE-05) and schema-violation path (EE-09) both call this function.
2. Add HTTP 409 guard in completeTask (and any other handler that modifies instance state): immediately after SELECT FOR UPDATE, check if status=ERROR and return CompleteTaskError.InstanceInError → HTTP 409.
3. Add CompleteTaskError.InstanceInError in src/engine/instance.zig and map it to HTTP 409 in the API error handler.
4. Refactor EE-05 (gateway no-match) and EE-09 (schema-violation) callers to call setInstanceError instead of inline ERROR logic if any inline logic exists.
5. Verify: zig build exits 0 and zig build test exits 0.

Security rules: no SQL string interpolation — all values via  placeholders. No I/O in transition.zig. Check anti-patterns.md before starting.
acceptance_criteria: setInstanceError function implemented in src/engine/instance.zig with correct atomic transaction (BEGIN, SELECT FOR UPDATE, INSERT EXECUTION_ERROR event, UPDATE projection status=ERROR + error_detail, COMMIT)
HTTP 409 guard in completeTask: returns InstanceInError when instance.status = ERROR before any write
Both EE-05 no-match path and EE-09 schema-violation path call setInstanceError (or already route through it)

result.summary: Implemented EE-10 (Execution error handling): added SetInstanceErrorError, ErrorType, EvaluatedCondition, SetInstanceErrorArgs types and setInstanceError method to InstanceStore; added CompleteTaskError.InstanceInError variant; added HTTP 409 guard in completeTask SELECT FOR UPDATE; refactored EE-09 schema-violation path and EE-05 NoMatchingEdge path to call setInstanceError with isolated transactions; updated tasks.zig to map InstanceInError to HTTP 409; added unit tests for all new types and error mappings.
